monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Now Supports Merged Ordering with JLCMC JLCCNC Now Supports Merged Ordering with JLCMC Product Update Dec 18, 2025 Table of Contents Three Reasons to Merge Your Orders How to Place a Merged Order Better Supporting Manufacturing Needs Through Stronger Platform Collaboration Media Contact: JLCCNC is thrilled to announce a significant upgrade to its ordering experience. Starting December 13, merged ordering capabilities have been further expanded across the JLCMC mechanical ecosystem. Previously, merged ordering was already available for services such as 3D printing and sheet metal fabrication. With this update, JLCCNC orders can now be combined with JLCMC products in the same checkout, with consolidated shipping and a unified batch number. Three Reasons to Merge Your Orders 1. One Workflow for Everything By adding products from different business lines to one cart, you reduce administrative overhead and eliminate the need to track multiple payment requests. 2. Reduced Logistics Costs Consolidated shipping allows you to bundle those diverse items into one package. This reduces the number of base-weight charges you pay and simplifies receiving logistics. 3. Unified Order Management Managing multiple order numbers increases the risk of error. You will receive a unified batch number for all your items, making tracking more intuitive and ensuring all parts of your project arrive together. How to Place a Merged Order 1. Add your CNC machining parts, along with other items such as JLCMC products, to your shopping cart. 2. Go to the Shopping Cart page and select the “All” checkbox to group your items from different platforms. 3. Confirm the merged order and the system will automatically generate a unified batch number and calculate a single shipping rate for the merged order. Better Supporting Manufacturing Needs Through Stronger Platform Collaboration With this enhancement, we make it easier to manage projects that involve multiple manufacturing methods and bulk production while maintaining consistent and reliable CNC machining services. JLCCNC will continue refining its services to help engineers and manufacturing teams reduce coordination effort and move more efficiently from design to production. About JLCCNC JLCCNC offers professional CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication services, supporting prototyping, small-batch production, and custom part manufacturing. With advanced production capabilities, a wide range of materials, and multiple surface finishing options, we deliver precise and reliable parts with efficient turnaround times to support engineers, designers, and manufacturers worldwide.
